seo.title: About Buzznerd — Builders, Marketers & AI Engineers for Dealerships
seo.description: Seattle-based builders, marketers, and AI engineers with deep dealership technology experience — we make marketing teams rock stars with the tech, content, and AI horsepower to do their best work.

sections.headline: Behind the AI are real humans.
sections.subheadline: Behind it all — the AI, the experience, the results — are real humans with names you'll know. Most of us have been here for years, and it shows: we answer the phone, we know your store, and we sweat the details so the tech actually works for your team.
sections.note: Builders, marketers, and AI engineers — obsessed with one thing: helping dealers sell more. Here's who we are.

sections.title: Real people, on the other end of the phone
We make them rock stars
sections.body: We hand your marketing team the tech, content, and AI horsepower to do their best work — so your people focus on what they do best while the platform does the heavy lifting.

sections.title: Big-tech talent, pointed at trucking.
sections.body:
Those humans are based in Seattle — one of the fastest-growing technology hubs in the country. We hired from a talent pool that's hard to match, then pointed all of it at one industry: yours.

We started by building websites for heavy-truck dealers the big vendors didn't understand. Today the platform powers 700+ dealership rooftops across the country.

sections.title: Three things, done extremely well.
sections.description: All that background boils down to a simple playbook we run for every store: strategy first, technology built lean, and marketing that's actually measured.

items.title: Strategy & Consulting
items.body: We identify the pain points in your digital customer experience, then build the plan that brings in — and keeps — more business.

items.title: Superior Technologies
items.body: Industry-leading tools kept lean, functional, and usable — with agile development that lets us make changes for clients on the fly.

items.title: Bulletproof Marketing
items.body: Countless hours of testing what actually works for dealerships. We haven't had a dissatisfied client yet — and don't plan on it.
